verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is GPU and DGX server hardware. A sandbox or test environment separated from production data is a feature of a service or API, so asking it of a hardware accelerator is a category error. The community evidence on NVSwitch partitioning and VFIO passthrough describes an implementer building isolated VMs with low-level primitives, not a sandbox or test-mode capability the product ships. That does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
